description: Énergie solaire, dès 2020 is a dataset listed in opendata.fr.ch open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Geoimpact, Office fédéral de l'énergie (OFEN). Ce jeu de données présente les chiffres annuels du taux d’exploitation du potentiel solaire et de la puissance des installations photovoltaïques, dans le canton de Fribourg et l'ensemble de la Suisse, depuis 2020. Coverage: Canton of Fribourg. The portal files it under Énergie. Its keywords are potentiel solaire, photovoltaïque, électricité, énergie. The portal shows 10 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-fr-ch-portal.
